subject.title: CLAW-526: Gate public publishes without breaking old CLIs

question: May Preview Proof execute an operator-supplied checkout ref inside the credential-bearing Test environment, or must the workflow validate trusted ancestry or remove environment access before running repository code?
rationale: This is a repository trust-boundary choice: the current workflow permits branch-controlled code execution in an environment job, and automation cannot decide which actors and refs maintainers intend to trust with Test credentials.

options.title: Isolate and validate the checkout
options.body: Run untrusted checkout validation without environment credentials, or require a full SHA proven reachable from an approved repository branch before entering the Test environment.

options.title: Restrict proof to main code
options.body: Keep the protected workflow code and executable scripts on main, passing only inert preview identifiers and expected SHA data into the job.

options.title: Accept trusted-dispatch execution
options.body: Document that every actor able to dispatch the workflow and every supplied ref is intentionally trusted with Test environment access.

recommendation.title: Isolate and validate the checkout
recommendation.body: Run untrusted checkout validation without environment credentials, or require a full SHA proven reachable from an approved repository branch before entering the Test environment.

likelyOwner.reason: They were the requested code-owner reviewer for the staged-publication feature and provide an independent routing point for this workflow security decision.
